name: John Smith (1781–1854)
role: Uncle of Joseph Smith, high councilor, and later patriarch
dateNote: He was named to the first Kirtland high council in February 1834.
importance: Section 102 lists him among the twelve high priests chosen as the first standing high council at Kirtland. From 1837 to 1844 he was an assistant counselor in the First Presidency. He later presided over the stake in Lee County, Iowa, and the first Salt Lake Stake. He became Presiding Patriarch in 1849.
connections: Brother of Joseph Smith Sr. and uncle of Joseph and Hyrum Smith. Father of the apostle George A. Smith.
